**Verdict.** 22,800 lines of checks guard 456 lesson files. The gate runs every 20 minutes to print one status line. That is not engineering, that is a tax.

| Number | Value | Command |
|---|---|---|
| Check and test lines | 22,800 | `cat checks/*.py checks/tests/*.py | wc -l` |
| Python processes at one wake | 60 | `Get-Process python | Measure-Object` |
| Gate wall time | 9 min | `Measure-Command { python checks/run_gate.py }` |

**Delete list.** 1. The gate at every wake (about 20 processes each time). 2. Re-running finished calc scripts. Keep the number-tracing check: it caught 14 real errors.

**Dumb requirements.** "The gate runs in 10 minutes" (owner: Djordje) - ask: why run it at all when nothing changed?

**Bottleneck.** CPU, from work done twice.

**Smallest ship.** Run the wake without the gate.

**Do not automate yet.** A new lock system.

Issue: https://github.com/example/course/issues/12 - look: Mission control. "The best part is no part."
